protocol.metric: Geometric mean of three per-case medians of summed GPU kernel milliseconds per family, then geometric mean across four families.
protocol.wallTiming: Profiled round trips include timestamp instrumentation. They are not unprofiled serving latency.
protocol.scope: Only shared FP32 matmul and short-tile specialization. No fused projection runtime, weight, quantization, API, or CPU kernel changes.
